content:
You are a domain driven design (DDD) expert.
Your task is to help the user step by step with creating domain models.

### Here is the explanation of the workflow:
1. The user will provide domain information.
2. Next You will carry out the modeling steps, but only once the user specifically requests it.

#### Modeling steps:
1. Extracting domain objects
2. Connections of domain objects using associations 
3. Grouping objects by subdomains
4. Definition of bounded contexts

Help me extract domain objects. Below I will provide domain information. 

#### Data:
This domain information covers the important domain events:
```json
{
  "domain-information": [
    "As a city resident, I want to find the nearest bike station, so that I can start my bike ride quickly.",
    "As a city resident, I want to rent a bike for a short ride, so that I can travel across town conveniently.",
    "As a city resident, I want to see available bikes at my home and work stations, so that I can plan my route.",
    "As a maintenance worker, I want to check bike conditions regularly, so that all bikes are safe to ride.",
    "As a city planner, I want to see bike usage patterns, so that I can improve station placement.",
    "As a city planner, I want to make a suggestion for station placement, so they align with the demand.",
    "As a city resident, I want to return the bike to any station, so that I have flexibility in my route.",
    "As a docking station manager, I want to track available docks, so that I can redistribute bikes when needed.",
    "As a city resident, I want to reserve a bike at a station, so that I am guaranteed transportation during peak hours.",
    "As a maintenance worker, I want to log repairs, so that the system knows which bikes are out of service.",
    "As a city resident, I want to report a damaged bike, so that it can be fixed promptly.",
    "As a city resident, I want to track my ride history, so that I can manage my transportation budget.",
    "As a system administrator, I want to analyze bike usage, so that I can redistribute them to high-demand areas.",
    "As a city resident, I want to know the pricing for trips, so that I can decide when to ride.",
    "As a maintenance worker, I want to schedule regular bike inspections, so that the fleet remains operational.",
    "As a city resident, I want to report stolen bikes, so that the system administrator can take action.",
    "As a system administrator, I want to manage stations, so that bike coverage is optimal.",
    "As a system Administrator, I want to issue a bike delivery, so that bikes are distributed from one station to another.",
    "As a bike delivery worker, I want to deliver bikes to another station, so that the station has supplies.",
    "As a system administrator, I want to review suggestions for station placements, so that I can approve or deny them.",
    "As a city resident, I want to participate in community events promoting biking, so that I contribute to sustainable transportation.",
    "As a community event manager, I want to plan a community event, so that city residents can participate.",
    "As a community event manager, I want to assign a station and a date for a community event."
  ]
}
```

#### Task:
- Identify the objects within this information. 
- Summarize it's meaning in a short description. 
- If you can make out attributes that are essential to the object, add them too. 
- Return the objects in json format. Here is an example for structuring the data:
```json
{
  "domain objects": [
    {
      "name": "...",
      "description": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```
